properties.description:

The National Weather Service in Green Bay has issued a

Western Marathon County in central Wisconsin...

* Until 515 PM CDT.

* At 427 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 15 miles west of
Rib Mountain, or 16 miles west of Wausau, moving southeast at 15
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Wausau around 500 PM CDT.

Other locations impacted by the severe thunderstorm include
Poniatowski, Rib Falls, Edgar, Fenwood and Marathon City.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 4 at 5:39PM EDT until September 4 at 5:45PM EDT by NWS Wilmington OH
properties.description:
The storm which prompted the warning has weakened below severe limits
and no longer poses an immediate threat to life or property.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.  However, gusty
winds are still possible with this thunderstorm.

Please report previous wind damage or hail to the National Weather
Service by going to our website at weather.gov/iln and submitting
your report via social media.
